blockers.summary: Canonical typed model is implemented; Lattice tokenizer/parser/compiler now cover the deterministic strict subset, but full grammar coverage (scope expressions, composition/alternatives, annotations, macros and context commands) remains incomplete.

Core semantic validation is implemented for identifiers, references, vocabulary, permission/profile contradictions, resource scope and evidence support; full RFC3339/BCP47 validation, delegation attenuation against authenticated parent authority and host execution-policy validation remain incomplete.
Canonical serializer/deserializer and frozen numeric/Unicode byte profile are not implemented.
Permission-aware host authorization, runtime policy enforcement and replay/idempotency hooks are not implemented.
Initial typed-model, semantic-validator and Lattice parser/compiler tests exist; full positive/negative conformance vectors and semantic round-trip fixtures remain incomplete.
Hostile-input, permission-escalation, evidence-provenance and unresolved-context conformance evidence remains incomplete.
No independent second implementation has passed the shared conformance vectors.
Whitepaper publication revision, source figures and reproducible publication build are incomplete.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented.
Final clean release audit, migration policy, canonicalization freeze, compatibility evidence and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
